skill.name: Commit/Clear
skill.strategic_description: Commits/clears a scoring move sequence: score increases, moves left decrease, and the state transitions from score appearing/disappearing markers into score_changed for the resulting board configuration.

steps: Execute the selected scoring action and stop intervening immediately
Observe automatic resolution until all transient effects fully settle
Confirm reward increased and resource count updated appropriately
Confirm the environment reached a stable resulting state
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

execution_hint.execution_description: Commits/clears a scoring move sequence: score increases, moves left decrease, and the state transitions from score appearing/disappearing markers into

preconditions: A valid scoring move has just been made and the board is in the post-swap clearing/animation phase.
Score gain indicators, disappearing candies, or other transient clear-resolution markers are present or expected.
The agent’s goal is to let the move fully resolve into the next stable board state.
steps: Stop issuing new match or swap inputs immediately after the scoring move is made.
Observe the board as candies clear, fall, and any cascades or automatic secondary matches resolve.
Monitor the score and confirm it increases from its previous value.
Monitor the moves counter and confirm it decreases by exactly one for the committed move, unless the game mode or a special effect explicitly changes this behavior.
Continue waiting through all score popups, disappearance effects, candy drops, and cascade animations.
Re-check the board after each automatic resolution step and keep waiting if any new clears or score markers appear.
When all animations and marker effects end, identify the resulting stable board configuration.
success_criteria: The score is higher than before the move resolved.
The moves remaining count has decreased appropriately for the committed move.
abort_criteria: The board does not begin or continue resolving after a reasonable wait, indicating the move may not have registered.
The score does not increase once resolution finishes.
The moves counter changes inconsistently with the committed move and cannot be explained by game rules or special effects.

skill.name: Commit/Match3
skill.strategic_description: Swap two adjacent candies to form a horizontal or vertical line of 3 same-color candies, scoring points and removing them from the board.

steps: Scan the board for swaps that would create a 3-in-a-row.
Among candidates, pick one not adjacent to an obstacle (cleaner cascade).
Execute the swap.
Verify match_scored and score_increased fired.
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

skill.name: Commit/Match4Stripe
skill.strategic_description: Form a 4-in-a-row match, which creates a striped candy that clears an entire row or column when activated — strictly preferred over plain 3-matches when available.

steps: Scan for swaps that would line up 4 same-color candies.
Pick the orientation (horizontal/vertical) that places the resulting striped candy near a dense area.
Execute the swap.
Verify match_scored fired and a striped candy now exists at the swap site.
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

skill.name: Commit/Match5Bomb
skill.strategic_description: Form a 5-in-a-row or T/L-shape match, which creates a color bomb or wrapped candy — the highest-value pattern in the game.

steps: Scan for swaps producing 5-in-a-row OR T/L shape.
Prefer T/L (wrapped candy) when adjacent to a blocker; line-5 (color bomb) otherwise.
Execute the swap.
Verify match_scored fired and a special candy spawned.
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

skill.name: Inspect/Cascade
skill.strategic_description: Before committing a 3-match, look for swaps where the resulting drop will create one or more secondary matches (cascade) — multiplies the score without spending extra moves.

steps: For each candidate 3-match swap, project the post-cascade board.
Count secondary matches in the projection.
Pick the swap maximizing cascade depth.
Execute the swap.
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

skill.name: Recover/Reshuffle
skill.strategic_description: When no valid match exists and the board has been reshuffled, take the highest-value match-3 that is now available (the reshuffle guarantees at least one).

steps: Detect board_reshuffled trigger.
Scan the new board for all available matches.
Pick the highest-value one (prefer 4+ over plain 3).
Execute the swap.
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

skill.name: Conserve/Moves
skill.strategic_description: Never spend a move on a swap that produces no match — every move must move_spent AND match_scored together; reject swaps that only trigger move_spent.

steps: For each candidate swap, verify it produces at least a 3-match.
Filter out swaps that would only consume a move without scoring.
Pick the highest-scoring valid swap.
Execute and verify both move_spent and match_scored fired.
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves
